description.value: TacoTime Canada is a coast-to-coast fast-food chain serving Mexican-inspired dishes — burritos, tacos, quesadillas, and their signature Mexi-Fries® — made fresh daily from Canadian-sourced ingredients. This Kamloops location sits in the Orchards Walk Plaza on Valleyview Drive, making it a convenient calorie stop for cyclists passing through the Thompson Valley corridor. Pickup, delivery (via SkipTheDishes and UberEats), and catering options are all available.
